audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-18 CLOSURE ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. BOTH report-018 boxes close at this single flip - the issue-18 opener chains part one (print 9, 14+19, 19, 31-32: the R934 part one - the Thompson insanity chart and doctrine, the McCloud laws of magic and the Kemble contest, the McAllister chamber of the godgame, the NPC pride, greed and work-quality tables) and the issue-18 opener chains part two (print 13, 23-24, 24: the R935 part two - the Sullin new spells levels one to six, the Eckert monkish weapons and the kedo combat matrix, the Coburn effective use of poison) - 2 closed / 0 open in tools/dragon_gap_report_018.md; the seven-chain walk completes in three rounds (the R934 opener part one carrying four chains, the R935 opener part two carrying three chains, this flip), the second three-round issue shape after issue 17. ISSUES 2-18 ALL CLOSED. Registry ground truth unchanged: 1313 loaded / 1338 base lua / 25 never-load (the R924 re-measure). Watch: the Sullin article ends its level 6 with a cont pg 21 promise but the levels 7-9 continuation NEVER PRINTS in TD18 - the watch rides to TD 19; the brawling long-term-effects sequel promised in issue 11 STILL does not print - watch TD 19.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-18 box closing round - the seven-chain walk complete, the pure flip
banner.provenance: Bookkeeping only, no new ink pinned. The issue-18 walk (the R934 opener part one carrying the four chains - insanity, the laws of magic, the godgame, the NPC tables; the R935 opener part two carrying the three chains - the new spells, the monkish weapons and kedo, the poison; this flip) covered The Dragon Vol. III No. 4 (September 1978), the Curtiss-provided scan voice, single-voice - the mistral transcript of the uploaded Dm18.pdf; no archive.org djvu cross-check exists for issue 18. PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE MINUS TWO, verified at the R934 page feet (folios 3, 9, 13, 14, 19, 21, 24 and 31 print at the PDF pages 5, 11, 15, 16, 21, 23, 26 and 33). Registry ground truth unchanged: 1313 loaded / 1338 base lua / 25 never-load (the R924 re-measure). Watch: the Sullin New Spells levels 7-9 (the cont pg 21 promise) NEVER printed in TD18 - watch TD 19; the brawling long-term-effects sequel STILL does not print - watch TD 19.
banner.sentinel: No print quirks ride this flip - the as-scanned garbles of the openers (the kedo attack list printing 2-8 with attack 1 never printed and the migi-do row matrix-only, the lone dar transposition, the six kedo diagonal breaks with the crossed migi-do and gyaku-do blocks, the doubled bowbow, the work-quality 03-20 band that never prints, the greed compound bands, the pride 00 percentile cell, the insanity odd 12, the poison A week and C hour conversions) stay pinned in the opener headers where they landed, noted never silent.
